title: Warmest cities of Africa
intro: In each round, pick the city with the highest mean annual air temperature. Values are grid-cell climatology, not station records.

questions.prompt: Which of these cities has the highest mean annual air temperature?
questions.explain: Mean annual air temperature (NASA POWER grid-cell climatology): Bissau 26.5 C, Durban 22.3 C, Cairo 21.8 C, Bujumbura 21.1 C.
